headline: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) Shares Housing Data, Is The Stock Fully Valued?
summary: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) just released its June 2026 First Look on mortgage delinquency, foreclosure, and prepayment trends, giving investors fresh housing market context ahead of the company’s upcoming earnings report. See our latest analysis for Intercontinental Exchange. Intercontinental Exchange’s share price has climbed 12.13% over the past month and 4.40% over the past week to US$145.79, but is still down 7.99% over three months. The 1 year total shareholder return has declined...
